data.max_tokens: Maximum tokens to return in response

data_description.prompt: Instruct how the LLM should respond. This can be a template.
data_description.llm_hass_api: Allow the model to interact with Home Assistant.
data_description.chat_model: Select the Groq model to use for conversations.
data_description.max_tokens: Maximum number of tokens the model can generate in a response.
data_description.temperature: Higher values make output more random, lower values more deterministic.
data_description.top_p: Nucleus sampling: consider tokens with top_p probability mass.
data_description.supports_reasoning: Enable this if the model supports reasoning effort configuration. When enabled, you can specify the reasoning effort level.
data_description.reasoning_effort: For Qwen models: 'default' or 'none'. For GPT-OSS models: 'low', 'medium', or 'high'. For other models, enter a custom value. The value is translated automatically when the fallback chain crosses model families.
data_description.history_budget: Approximate token budget for the conversation history sent on every request. Groq counts input + output against the same per-minute limit, and the whole history is resent each turn, so without a budget a long conversation eventually exceeds the limit and then fails permanently. Leave room for max_tokens.
data_description.model_chain: Models to try, in order, when the main one is rate limited. Groq's limits are per model, so each entry adds its own token-per-minute window.
data_description.model_cooldown: Seconds to avoid reusing a model after it was used. Rotates before Groq rejects, saving the round trip of a 429. A model on cooldown is moved to the end of the list, never dropped. Set to 0 to disable.
data_description.cf_account_id: Optional last-resort fallback on Cloudflare Workers AI, used only when every Groq model is out of quota. Leave empty to disable.
data_description.cf_api_token: Token with the Workers AI permission. WARNING: this sends your conversations to a third party — leave it empty if you would rather not.
data_description.reasoning_effort_chain: Applies only to the fallback chain, separately from the primary model. A fallback kicks in exactly when quota is scarce, and if it spends its budget thinking it comes back empty and you hear nothing, so 'none' is recommended. The value is translated automatically to each model's family.
